# Apex Mineral Ventures

> Apex Mineral Ventures is a licensed mineral trading, assay facilitation, and export advisory company based in Kampala, Uganda, operating across East Africa and the Great Lakes region. We specialize in verified sourcing for gold in Uganda, compliant trade corridors for gold in Congo (DRC), and transparent supply chains for gold in Africa, providing certified laboratory testing, ICGLR/OECD compliance, full export paperwork, and secure bank escrow settlement.

## About

- [About Apex Mineral Ventures](https://apexmineral.ug/about): Our background, operating principles, ethical sourcing commitments, and how we help buyers source minerals safely and legally from Uganda.
- [Why Choose Us](https://apexmineral.ug/why-us): Key differentiators — verified sources, certified lab testing, complete legal compliance, and protected payments.

## Services

- [Precious Metals Trading](https://apexmineral.ug/services/precious-metals-trading): Secure gold and precious metals trading with verified sourcing, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance.
- [Mining Advisory](https://apexmineral.ug/services/mining-advisory): Expert guidance on Uganda's mining sector, regulatory navigation, licensing support, and investment due diligence.
- [Export Facilitation](https://apexmineral.ug/services/export-facilitation): End-to-end support for mineral export documentation, regulatory permits, logistics coordination, and customs clearance.
- [Transaction Security](https://apexmineral.ug/services/transaction-security): Due diligence, documentation verification, escrow coordination, and secure transaction protocols.
- [Secure Storage](https://apexmineral.ug/services/secure-storage): Coordination of secure storage options for minerals during transaction processing and export preparation.

## Knowledge Base

- [Uganda Mining License Guide](https://apexmineral.ug/resources/understanding-uganda-mining-licenses): Comprehensive guide to Uganda's mining license categories — artisanal, small-scale, medium-scale, large-scale, exploration, and retention licenses.
- [Mineral Export Documentation](https://apexmineral.ug/resources/mineral-export-documentation-requirements): Essential documentation for legally exporting minerals from Uganda — permits, certificates, and compliance procedures.
- [Responsible Mineral Sourcing](https://apexmineral.ug/resources/responsible-mineral-sourcing-practices): OECD due diligence frameworks, ICGLR certification, supply chain transparency, and ethical sourcing best practices.
- [Gold Assay & Quality Verification](https://apexmineral.ug/resources/gold-quality-verification-methods): Gold purity standards (karat, fineness), assay methods (fire assay, XRF, acid testing), and LBMA trading standards.
- [Mining Investment Due Diligence](https://apexmineral.ug/resources/mining-investment-due-diligence): Regulatory, technical, financial, and operational due diligence for mining investments in Uganda.
